name: ARC Raiders
notes: Works with the Steam default Proton — Easy Anti-Cheat is supported. In the game's Accessibility settings, turn on 'Bring game to foreground on match found': it stops the freeze when a match is found. If the game is stuck at 60 FPS or crashes when you alt-tab, try Native Wayland (needs GE-Proton or Proton-CachyOS). NVIDIA: DLSS works.
